items.exampleEn: I enjoy all kinds of sports, particularly tennis.
items.exampleZh: 我喜歡各種運動，尤其是網球。

items.exampleEn: A small amount of salt makes the soup taste better.
items.exampleZh: 加少量的鹽會讓湯更好喝。

items.exampleEn: I spent the entire day at home.
They live in a huge house by the sea.
items.exampleZh: 他們住在海邊一棟很大的房子裡。

items.exampleEn: Can you measure the size of this window?
items.exampleZh: 你可以量一下這扇窗戶的尺寸嗎？

items.exampleEn: The total cost of the trip was two thousand dollars.
items.exampleZh: 這趟旅行的總費用是兩千美元。

items.exampleEn: The majority of students take the bus to school.
items.exampleZh: 大多數學生搭公車上學。

items.exampleEn: I think you are absolutely right about that.
items.exampleZh: 我覺得你說的完全正確。

items.sentenceEn: The entire office was quiet on Friday afternoon.
items.sentenceZh: 星期五下午整間辦公室都很安靜。

items.audioEn: The majority of our customers are young people, particularly students.
items.audioZh: 我們大部分的顧客是年輕人，尤其是學生。
items.questionZh: 他們的顧客大多是什麼人？

items.sentenceEn: The total number of visitors this year is over ten thousand.
items.sentenceZh: 今年的訪客總數超過一萬人。

items.sentenceEn: This dress looks absolutely beautiful on you.
items.sentenceZh: 這件洋裝你穿起來美極了。

items.stemEn: The new stadium is ____; it can hold fifty thousand people.
items.stemZh: 新體育場非常大，可以容納五萬人。

items.stemEn: Please tell me the exact ____ of money you need.
items.stemZh: 請告訴我你需要的確切金額。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, our company moved to a huge new office. The entire move took two days. Before the move, we had to measure every desk to make sure it would fit. The total cost was higher than expected, particularly because of the new chairs. But the majority of the staff love the new place. It has a large amount of natural light, and the views are absolutely beautiful.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們公司搬到一間很大的新辦公室。整個搬家過程花了兩天。搬家前，我們得量每一張桌子，確定放得下。總費用比預期高，尤其是因為新椅子。不過大部分員工都很喜歡新地方。那裡有大量的自然光，景色也美極了。

questions.questionZh: 搬家前員工必須做什麼？
總費用為什麼比預期高？

items.promptZh: 大部分的人都同意這個計畫。
referenceEn: The majority of people agree with this plan.
Most people agree with the plan.
rubricZh: the majority of＋複數名詞，表示「大多數的⋯」
「同意這個計畫」可寫 agree with the plan、support the plan 等
寫 Most people… 意思也正確

items.instructionZh: 用 measure 造一個句子，說說你曾經量過什麼東西、為什麼量。
referenceEn: I measured my room before I bought a new bed.
I measured the box to see if it would fit in my car.
rubricZh: measure 表示「測量」，後面直接接要量的東西
過去的經驗可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 measured）
